CFB Schedule & Scores 2026

Every FBS game of 2026, week by week. For each one: who GordStats picks and how sure it is, which side it would take against the DraftKings number and the Over/Under, with ESPN's FPI and SP+ stacked beside them; both teams' record, ATS, points, ratings and last five; and the kickoff forecast. More opens every book's line and how it has moved. This week's scores update in place while games are on. 212 upcoming games have a book line and 181 a forecast so far. Rebuilt daily (last: Sep 8, 11:01 PM EDT).

What the columns and tags mean
  • Lines — every read of the game stacked so they can be compared: the GS row is this site's model and is highlighted because it is the pick (favourite, projected total, and that team's win chance); DK is the DraftKings spread, total and moneylines as ESPN carries them, captured before kickoff and frozen; FPI is ESPN's Football Power Index favourite and win chance; SP+ is Bill Connelly's ratings read as a spread with home field added. Under the table is the call, in one line: the score the model expects, then the DraftKings spread and total it would take — GordStats projects 19–34, recommend M-OH +16.5 and Under 47.5. Hover either number for how far the model and the book are apart; three points or more is a strong lean and gets the Strong leans filter. Within half a point it says the model agrees with the book, and names nothing. A finished game shows what was on record before kickoff, never a refit, with ✓ or ✗ on each. Read these as where the model disagrees with the book rather than as tips: on the games scored so far it is under break-even against the spread, which the predictions page keeps an honest count of.
  • Under each team — GordStats rating (points better than an average FBS team), FPI and SP+ rank (hover for the rating, and SP+ offence and defence ranks), and the last five results as W/L chips with the score on hover.
  • Season — away team over home: record, against-the-spread and over/under records this season (counted here against the closing DraftKings line, since ESPN publishes none for college football), and points scored and allowed per game.
  • Weather — ESPN's AccuWeather forecast for kickoff, which appears about ten days out: conditions, temperature, chance of rain, gusts. Bad weather means rain, storms or snow, a 50%+ chance of rain, gusts of 25+ mph, or a kickoff at or below freezing.
  • Tags — Home dog: the home team is the underdog on the book's line (the model's, if there is no book line yet). Toss-up: the spread is three points or fewer. Upset: the favourite lost. Upset watch in the filters: the model or FPI gives the underdog at least a 35% chance, or the two disagree on who is favoured.
  • More on any game opens every book's line (DraftKings from ESPN; Bovada and others from CollegeFootballData) with how each has moved since it opened, our archive of the DraftKings line day by day, the implied final score and moneyline chance, and where GordStats and SP+ lean against the number.
  • Sorting by anything other than kickoff turns the week into one ranked list; games without the figure being sorted on fall to the bottom. Matchup quality is ESPN's 0–100 measure of how competitive and consequential a game projects to be.
